Privacy note

This interactive archive is created solely as a private, historical tribute for the alumni and faculty of the 1990-91 Mechanical Engineering batch of Government Engineering College Raipur (now National Institute of Technology Raipur).

Zero external data transmission: Any notes, current city information, role updates, or campus memories entered on this site are stored locally in your browser storage (localStorage). No form data, personal contact details, or profile changes are uploaded to any external server or tracking network.

Optical pixel integrity: No generative artificial intelligence models or synthetic face regeneration tools are used on this archive. Original photograph pixels from the 1991 physical print are preserved verbatim.

Terms of use

The photograph and printed name roster are historical records from the 1991 convocation mount. This website is intended solely for batchmates, faculty members, and their families to reconnect and celebrate the 35th graduation milestone.

If you are an alumnus or faculty family member and wish to correct any name spelling or request an adjustment to your profile display, please reach out directly to the batch coordination committee.

Govt. Engineering College Raipur, now NIT Raipur. B.E. Mechanical, Class of 1991.
